title.zh: 要求政府拥有或控制的公司、机构或单位缴纳税款、关税、规费及其他费用的法案
title.en: An Act Requiring Corporations, Agencies or Instrumentalities Owned or Controlled by the Government to Pay Taxes, Duties, Fees, and Other Charges
title.orig: An Act Requiring Corporations, Agencies or Instrumentalities Owned or Controlled by the Government to Pay Taxes, Duties, Fees, and Other Charges

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_104_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All corporations, agencies or instrumentalities owned or controlled by the Government shall pay such duties, taxes, fees and other charges upon their transaction, business, industry, sale or income as are imposed by law upon individuals, associations or corporations engaged in any taxable business, industry, or activity, except on goods or commodities imported or purchased and sold or distributed for relief purposes as may be determined by the President of the Philippines.
All acts or parts of acts which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 2, 1947
